Also flag any test that is unsupported by its cited memory evidence, ambiguous, gives away the expected answer in its wording, or cannot distinguish whether the target used the memory appropriately. For each test with a coverage_slot, separately check whether BOTH its prompt and expected behaviour test that slot's stated intent and exact relationship signature. Judge the behaviour elicited by the question together with its reference answer, not whether the question literally names a dimension, intent label, relationship type or memory IDs. Natural neutral wording is allowed. Accuracy can be a plain recall question and needs no relationship. Freshness can ask what applies now when the reference distinguishes current and replaced values. Conflict can ask what to clarify when the reference preserves both incompatible requirements. Appropriate Use can ask for a task recommendation when the reference respects that scope and the general preference. A conflict slot must test the cited conflict rather than another edge between the same memories. memories.canonical_value: The Maple capstone backend used MySQL previously.
We migrated the Maple capstone backend to PostgreSQL; MySQL is no longer used there.
In general, I prefer Python for backend projects.
For Maple capstone backend work, the course requires Java only; that requirement applies to this capstone project.
The current deployment plan for the Maple capstone says the production region is North.
The signed client brief for the same Maple capstone deployment says the production region is South.
Both deployment documents are still active; I have not established which instruction controls.
